selected_evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the package and repository metadata with matching SHA-256, plus the enabled HTTP service, port 8080 listener, and successful repository response through node1's managed IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
selected_evidence.summary: Shows Ubuntu archive/security connections refused while fresh local indexes succeed, followed by APT fetching local-repo-demo from node1, installing it, and successfully running its executable.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both initial and post-restart evidence show Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic.

Captures the healthy pre-restart boot ID and repository/package state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, running system with zero failed units, recovered repository and matching artifact, persisted installed package, and post-restart APT provenance while remote repositories remain unreachable.
